graderOnly: A lint job alone satisfies DEV-001; no deployment, scanning, or branch-protection change is needed.

The repository documents no action-pinning policy. Before the run, the only action references are actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-python@v5 in the existing test job, referenced by major tag; the workflow has no permissions block, no timeout-minutes, and no concurrency group.

GitHub is unreachable during the run, so action commit SHAs cannot be looked up online. A run that pins a SHA must not present an unverifiable SHA as verified; stating that a pin could not be verified is acceptable.
ruff is declared in the dev extra of pyproject.toml with an exact version, and [tool.ruff] configuration already exists, so the lint job needs no change outside .github/workflows/ci.yml.
The existing test suite passes on the committed tree (python3 -m pytest in the runner; the image has python3 but no python command).

all.why: the lint job is added to the existing workflow file
the original workflow has no permissions block, so one must have been added
the original workflow has no timeout-minutes; the new job needs one
the existing test job's checkout step is not rewritten
the existing test job's setup-python step is not rewritten
the existing test step is kept
the existing install step is kept
no dependabot, settings/branch-protection, CODEOWNERS, or similar file is added directly under .github

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the existing test suite passes on the committed tree
the existing workflow uses actions/checkout@v4 and has no permissions block or timeout
no documented action-pinning policy in the project docs or workflow

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 10 (pre-install) commits a small Python package `tally` (src layout, pytest with pythonpath=src, ruff configured in pyproject and declared with an exact version in the dev extra, Makefile lint/test targets). Layer 20 (pre-install) commits .github/workflows/ci.yml with a single `test` job using actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-python@v5, no permissions block, no timeout, no concurrency. Layer 50 commits STATE.md (EXPEDITED, DEVELOPING, CompletionPolicy NONE, Scope/Architecture NONE, Handoff INITIAL with an expedited mode-entry reason, BlockedOn NONE after approval) and the approved development plan (Mode AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE locked, Status APPROVED, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE) whose DEV-001 (PENDING, EXPEDITED_REQUEST) adds a separate lint job to ci.yml. No pinning policy is documented anywhere. GitHub is unreachable by default, so SHAs cannot be resolved online; assertion 2's SHA genuineness and the checkout ambiguity are left to the judge. The runner image has python3 but no python command, so selfChecks and the plan's local self-check use python3; the CI workflow itself keeps `python -m pytest`, which setup-python provides on GitHub runners.
